candidates.description: This vector represents characters, locations, and terminology from the Harry Potter universe.
This vector represents human beings, particularly family members, children, and people of various ages and relationships.
This feature vector represents various genres, mediums, and formats of storytelling and entertainment across different languages.
This feature vector represents positive sentiment, well-being, and common affirmative expressions in Spanish and English.
This vector represents common masculine given names in English.
This vector represents various subjects, entities, or domains of human interest and activity.
These tokens represent integers corresponding to days of the month.
This vector is related to Spanish verbs and action-oriented actions and states across various tenses.
These tokens represent Spanish modal and auxiliary verbs expressing possibility, obligation, or capacity, along with a few common verbs in past and future tenses.
These tokens represent common English female given names.
